topic: Health Insurance Options After Missing ACA Open Enrollment 2026

title.en: Missed Open Enrollment 2026? Your Options Now | CoveredUSA
title.es: ¿Perdió la Inscripción Abierta 2026? Sus Opciones | CoveredUSA

description.en: Missed ACA Open Enrollment 2026? You may still qualify for Medicaid, a 60-day SEP, or CHIP. Learn every option available in 2026 before the next OEP.
description.es: ¿Perdió la Inscripción Abierta 2026? Puede calificar para Medicaid, un SEP de 60 días o CHIP. Conozca cada opción disponible en 2026 antes del próximo OEP.

h1.en: Missed Open Enrollment 2026? Here Are Your Health Insurance Options Right Now
h1.es: ¿Perdio la Inscripcion Abierta 2026? Estas Son Sus Opciones de Seguro Ahora

subhero.en: ACA Open Enrollment for 2026 coverage closed January 15, 2026. If you missed it, three paths may still be open: Medicaid year-round if income qualifies, a 60-day Special Enrollment Period if you had a qualifying life event, or a short-term bridge while you wait for the next Open Enrollment starting November 1, 2026.
subhero.es: La Inscripcion Abierta del ACA para cobertura 2026 cerro el 15 de enero de 2026. Si la perdio, tres caminos pueden estar abiertos: Medicaid todo el ano si sus ingresos califican, un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias si tuvo un evento calificador, o un puente temporal mientras espera la proxima Inscripcion Abierta el 1 de noviembre de 2026.

heading.en: If you had a qualifying life event in 2026, you have 60 days from that event to enroll
heading.es: Si tuvo un evento calificador de vida en 2026, tiene 60 dias desde ese evento para inscribirse

body.en: ACA Open Enrollment for 2026 Marketplace coverage closed January 15, 2026. If a qualifying life event occurred after that date (job loss, marriage, birth, move, loss of Medicaid), your 60-day Special Enrollment Period runs from that event date. For example, if you lost job coverage on May 1, 2026, your SEP window runs May 1 through June 30, 2026. Without a qualifying event, your primary option is Medicaid year-round (if income qualifies), and the next OEP opens November 1, 2026 for 2027 coverage.
body.es: La Inscripcion Abierta del ACA para cobertura 2026 cerro el 15 de enero de 2026. Si ocurrio un evento calificador despues de esa fecha (perdida de empleo, matrimonio, nacimiento, mudanza, perdida de Medicaid), su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias corre desde esa fecha. Sin un evento calificador, su opcion principal es Medicaid todo el ano (si los ingresos califican), y el proximo OEP abre el 1 de noviembre de 2026.

label.es: Medicaid y CHIP (todo el ano, sin fecha limite)
Proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA: 1 de noviembre de 2026

label.en: COBRA (60 days from qualifying event, if recently had employer coverage)
label.es: COBRA (60 dias desde el evento calificador, si tuvo cobertura del empleador recientemente)

quickAnswer.en: Missing ACA Open Enrollment is not the end of coverage options in 2026. Four paths remain: (1) Medicaid enrollment is year-round and free if your household income is under 138% FPL in expansion states ($22,025 for one person, $45,540 for a family of four in 2026); (2) CHIP covers children year-round up to 200 to 300% FPL depending on your state; (3) a 60-day Special Enrollment Period opens if you had a qualifying life event such as job loss, marriage, birth, a move, or loss of Medicaid since OEP closed; (4) the next ACA Open Enrollment for 2027 coverage opens November 1, 2026 on healthcare.gov. Check Medicaid first since it is free and the fastest path for lower incomes.
quickAnswer.es: Perder la Inscripcion Abierta del ACA no es el fin de las opciones de cobertura en 2026. Cuatro caminos permanecen: (1) La inscripcion en Medicaid es todo el ano y gratuita si el ingreso del hogar esta por debajo del 138% FPL en estados con expansion ($22,025 para una persona, $45,540 para una familia de cuatro en 2026); (2) CHIP cubre ninos todo el ano hasta el 200 al 300% FPL segun su estado; (3) un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias se abre si tuvo un evento calificador desde que cerro el OEP; (4) la proxima Inscripcion Abierta para cobertura 2027 abre el 1 de noviembre de 2026 en healthcare.gov. Verifique primero Medicaid, ya que es gratuito.

introParagraphs.en: ACA Open Enrollment for 2026 coverage closed on January 15, 2026 on healthcare.gov and most state-based marketplaces. If you are reading this page in mid-2026 without health insurance, you are not alone. Millions of Americans miss the annual window, typically because of busy schedules, confusion about eligibility, or unexpected life changes. The key question now is not why you missed it but what happens next. Three paths can lead to coverage before the next Open Enrollment: Medicaid if your income is low enough, a qualifying life event SEP if something changed in your life since January, or a short-term stopgap while you wait. The 2026 subsidy cliff at 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person, $132,000 for a family of four) returned this year after enhanced PTCs expired January 1, 2026, so Marketplace plans without a subsidized SEP can be expensive at higher incomes. Start with the Medicaid income check and work down the list from there.
introParagraphs.es: La Inscripcion Abierta del ACA para cobertura 2026 cerro el 15 de enero de 2026 en healthcare.gov y en la mayoria de los mercados estatales. Si esta leyendo esta pagina a mediados de 2026 sin seguro medico, no esta solo. Millones de estadounidenses pierden la ventana anual, generalmente por agendas ocupadas, confusion sobre la elegibilidad o cambios de vida inesperados. La pregunta clave ahora no es por que la perdio, sino que sigue. Tres caminos pueden llevar a cobertura antes de la proxima Inscripcion Abierta: Medicaid si sus ingresos son lo suficientemente bajos, un SEP de evento calificador si algo cambio en su vida desde enero, o una solucion temporal mientras espera. El precipicio de subsidio del 400% FPL regreso en 2026 despues de que los creditos fiscales mejorados expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026, por lo que los planes del Mercado sin un SEP subsidiado pueden ser costosos con ingresos mas altos.

introParagraphs.en: Medicaid income limits in 2026 sit at 138% of the Federal Poverty Level in the 40 states plus DC that expanded Medicaid under the ACA. That is $22,025 for a single person or $45,540 for a family of four based on the 2026 HHS poverty guidelines published by the Department of Health and Human Services. State Medicaid programs use different brand names: California's Medi-Cal, Arizona's AHCCCS, Wisconsin's BadgerCare, Massachusetts's MassHealth, Washington's Apple Health, and Connecticut's HUSKY Health. Applications go through healthcare.gov or directly to the state agency and are accepted year-round with no enrollment window. If you had a qualifying life event such as losing job-based coverage, getting married, having a baby, or moving to a new state, that event triggered a 60-day Special Enrollment Period starting on the event date. Check the date of any life change against the 60-day clock before concluding you have no SEP path. The ACA income limits for 2026 start at 100% FPL for subsidy eligibility and cap subsidy eligibility at 400% FPL per the ACA income limits schedule.
introParagraphs.es: Los limites de ingresos de Medicaid en 2026 estan en el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza en los 40 estados mas DC que expandieron Medicaid bajo el ACA. Eso es $22,025 para una persona sola o $45,540 para una familia de cuatro segun las pautas de pobreza HHS 2026. Los programas estatales de Medicaid usan diferentes nombres de marca: Medi-Cal de California, AHCCCS de Arizona, BadgerCare de Wisconsin, MassHealth de Massachusetts, Apple Health de Washington, y HUSKY Health de Connecticut. Las solicitudes se procesan a traves de healthcare.gov o directamente en la agencia estatal y se aceptan todo el ano sin ventana de inscripcion. Si tuvo un evento calificador como perder cobertura del trabajo, casarse, tener un bebe o mudarse a un nuevo estado, ese evento activo un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias a partir de la fecha del evento.

name.es: Verifique primero la elegibilidad de Medicaid

text.en: Apply through healthcare.gov or your state Medicaid agency to check eligibility for your household. In the 40 expansion states plus DC, anyone with household income under 138% FPL qualifies in 2026 ($22,025 for one person, $45,540 for a family of four). Medicaid enrollment is year-round with no deadline. Coverage can start as soon as the following month after approval, and some states offer retroactive coverage for the prior three months.
text.es: Solicite a traves de healthcare.gov o su agencia estatal de Medicaid para verificar la elegibilidad de su hogar. En los 40 estados con expansion mas DC, cualquiera con ingresos del hogar por debajo del 138% FPL califica en 2026. La inscripcion en Medicaid es todo el ano sin fecha limite.

name.en: Check children for CHIP eligibility regardless of your own income
name.es: Verifique la elegibilidad de CHIP para los ninos independientemente de su propio ingreso

text.en: CHIP (Children's Health Insurance Program) covers children under 19 in households earning too much for Medicaid but not enough for easy Marketplace coverage, typically up to 200 to 300% FPL depending on the state. CHIP enrollment is year-round. Apply through healthcare.gov or your state agency. Premiums are very low or free. Even if you do not qualify for Medicaid yourself, your children may qualify for CHIP.
text.es: CHIP (Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos) cubre a ninos menores de 19 anos en hogares que ganan demasiado para Medicaid pero no lo suficiente para el Mercado, tipicamente hasta el 200 al 300% FPL. La inscripcion en CHIP es todo el ano. Solicite a traves de healthcare.gov o su agencia estatal.

name.en: Look back for a qualifying life event since January 15, 2026
name.es: Busque un evento calificador de vida desde el 15 de enero de 2026

text.en: Qualifying life events that trigger a 60-day Marketplace Special Enrollment Period include losing job-based coverage, getting married, having or adopting a child, moving to a new state or county with different plan availability, and losing Medicaid or CHIP coverage. Count back 60 days from today. If the event occurred within that window, you may still have time to enroll in a Marketplace SEP at healthcare.gov. Document the event before calling healthcare.gov.
text.es: Los eventos calificadores de vida que activan un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado de 60 dias incluyen perder cobertura del trabajo, casarse, tener o adoptar un hijo, mudarse a un nuevo estado o condado con diferente disponibilidad de planes, y perder cobertura de Medicaid o CHIP. Cuente 60 dias atras desde hoy para ver si un evento reciente todavia abre una ventana.

name.en: If you had recent employer coverage, evaluate COBRA
name.es: Si tuvo cobertura reciente del empleador, evalue COBRA

text.en: COBRA continuation coverage lets you keep your former employer's health plan for up to 18 months (36 months in some situations like divorce) at 102% of the full premium. The COBRA election window is 60 days from your qualifying event. In 2026, COBRA typically costs $400 to $900 per month for an individual and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for family coverage. Compare COBRA premiums against Marketplace SEP plans with premium tax credits before electing COBRA.
text.es: La cobertura de continuacion COBRA le permite mantener el plan de salud de su ex empleador por hasta 18 meses (36 meses en algunas situaciones como divorcio) al 102% de la prima completa. La ventana de eleccion de COBRA es de 60 dias desde su evento calificador. En 2026, COBRA tipicamente cuesta $400 a $900 por mes para un individuo.

name.en: Calculate your projected 2026 income for subsidy eligibility
name.es: Calcule su ingreso proyectado de 2026 para la elegibilidad de subsidio

text.en: ACA Marketplace premium tax credits use Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) based on your projected full-year income. If your income dropped (from job loss, for example), update your income estimate on healthcare.gov immediately. A lower projected income means a larger subsidy. The 2026 subsidy cliff returned at 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person, $132,000 for a family of four) after enhanced PTCs expired January 1, 2026. Check the ACA income limits chart to see where your household falls.
text.es: Los creditos fiscales de primas del Mercado ACA usan el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) basado en su ingreso proyectado para todo el ano. Si sus ingresos bajaron, actualice su estimacion de ingresos en healthcare.gov de inmediato. El precipicio de subsidio 2026 regreso al 400% FPL ($63,840 para una persona sola, $132,000 para una familia de cuatro).

name.en: Mark November 1, 2026 on your calendar for next Open Enrollment
name.es: Marque el 1 de noviembre de 2026 en su calendario para la proxima Inscripcion Abierta

text.en: The next ACA Open Enrollment for 2027 coverage opens November 1, 2026 and closes January 15, 2027 on healthcare.gov. Enroll by December 15, 2026 for coverage starting January 1, 2027. Set a reminder now. If you have no qualifying event and do not qualify for Medicaid, a short-term limited-duration plan may serve as a temporary bridge, but these plans do not cover pre-existing conditions and are not ACA-compliant.
text.es: La proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA para cobertura 2027 abre el 1 de noviembre de 2026 y cierra el 15 de enero de 2027 en healthcare.gov. Inscribase antes del 15 de diciembre de 2026 para que la cobertura comience el 1 de enero de 2027. Establezca un recordatorio ahora.

name.en: Enroll using the correct SEP or Medicaid pathway and submit documentation
name.es: Inscribase usando la via correcta de SEP o Medicaid y envie la documentacion

text.en: Log in to healthcare.gov (or your state exchange) and select the Special Enrollment Period reason that matches your qualifying event. Upload documentation: termination letter for job loss, marriage certificate for marriage, birth certificate for a new child, proof of prior coverage end date. For Medicaid, submit the application and await the eligibility determination, which typically takes a few days to a few weeks. Keep confirmation of submission as proof of timely application.
text.es: Inicie sesion en healthcare.gov (o su mercado estatal) y seleccione el motivo del Periodo de Inscripcion Especial que coincide con su evento calificador. Cargue documentacion: carta de despido para perdida de empleo, acta de matrimonio, acta de nacimiento para un nuevo hijo, prueba de fecha de fin de cobertura anterior. Para Medicaid, envie la solicitud y espere la determinacion de elegibilidad.

COBRA costs reflect 2026 average employer plan premiums. Short-term plans are not ACA-compliant and do not cover pre-existing conditions or essential health benefits.

intro.en: The most costly mistakes people make after missing Open Enrollment:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que la gente comete despues de perder la Inscripcion Abierta:

items.en: Assuming no options exist after January 15. Medicaid and CHIP are year-round, and a qualifying life event opens a 60-day SEP that most people are not aware of.
items.es: Asumir que no existen opciones despues del 15 de enero. Medicaid y CHIP son todo el ano, y un evento calificador abre un SEP de 60 dias del que la mayoria no esta enterada.

items.en: Not checking for a qualifying life event. Job loss, marriage, divorce, birth, adoption, a move, or loss of Medicaid all open a 60-day Special Enrollment Period. Many people have one and do not realize it.
items.es: No verificar si existe un evento calificador de vida. La perdida de empleo, matrimonio, divorcio, nacimiento, adopcion, mudanza o perdida de Medicaid abren un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias.

items.en: Enrolling in a short-term plan and assuming it provides full coverage. Short-term limited-duration plans are not ACA-compliant, can deny claims for pre-existing conditions, and do not count as minimum essential coverage for the 1095-A filing.
items.es: Inscribirse en un plan a corto plazo asumiendo cobertura completa. Los planes de duracion limitada a corto plazo no son conformes con el ACA, pueden negar reclamos por condiciones preexistentes y no cuentan como cobertura esencial minima.

items.en: Using prior-year income instead of projected current-year income for subsidy calculations. Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for ACA subsidies is based on what you project to earn in the current year, not last year's tax return.
items.es: Usar ingresos del ano anterior en lugar de ingresos proyectados del ano actual para calculos de subsidio. El MAGI para subsidios del ACA se basa en lo que proyecta ganar en el ano actual, no en la declaracion de impuestos del ano pasado.

items.en: Waiting for the next Open Enrollment when Medicaid is immediately available. If household income is under 138% FPL in an expansion state, Medicaid enrollment takes days, not months, and coverage is retroactive in some states.
items.es: Esperar la proxima Inscripcion Abierta cuando Medicaid esta disponible inmediatamente. Si el ingreso del hogar esta por debajo del 138% FPL en un estado con expansion, la inscripcion en Medicaid toma dias, no meses.

items.en: Missing the COBRA election window. COBRA must be elected within 60 days of the qualifying event. Miss that window and COBRA is gone, leaving only Medicaid, the next OEP, or a qualifying-event SEP.
items.es: Perder la ventana de eleccion de COBRA. COBRA debe elegirse dentro de los 60 dias del evento calificador. Si pierde esa ventana, COBRA desaparece, dejando solo Medicaid, el proximo OEP, o un SEP de evento calificador.

heading.en: Do You Actually Have a Qualifying Life Event? Check This List
heading.es: Tiene Realmente un Evento Calificador de Vida? Revise Esta Lista

paragraphs.en: Qualifying life events (QLEs) that open a 60-day Special Enrollment Period on the ACA Marketplace are broader than most people realize. The most common qualifying events in 2026 include: losing job-based health coverage (whether you were laid off, resigned, or had hours reduced below the coverage threshold); getting married or entering a domestic partnership (recognized in some states); having, adopting, or being placed for adoption of a child; moving to a new state or a new county where your current plan is not available; losing Medicaid or CHIP coverage due to a redetermination or income change; aging off a parent's plan at 26; release from incarceration; and gaining or becoming a dependent under a court order. Healthcare.gov also recognizes specific circumstances such as errors by the Marketplace, plan discontinuation, and certain immigration status changes. If any of these events happened to you since January 15, 2026, count exactly 60 calendar days from the event date. If today falls within that window, you can still enroll. Document the event thoroughly before calling healthcare.gov or going online.
paragraphs.es: Los eventos calificadores de vida que abren un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias en el Mercado ACA son mas amplios de lo que la mayoria cree. Los eventos calificadores mas comunes en 2026 incluyen: perder cobertura de salud del trabajo (ya sea despido, renuncia o reduccion de horas); casarse o entrar en una asociacion domestica; tener, adoptar o ser colocado para adopcion de un hijo; mudarse a un nuevo estado o condado donde su plan actual no esta disponible; perder cobertura de Medicaid o CHIP por una redeterminacion; cumplir 26 anos y salir del plan de los padres; salir de la carcel; y convertirse en dependiente por orden judicial. Si alguno de estos eventos le ocurrio desde el 15 de enero de 2026, cuente exactamente 60 dias calendario desde la fecha del evento.

paragraphs.en: The Medicaid Unwinding process that began in 2023 continues to generate qualifying events in 2026. States are still redetermining Medicaid eligibility for millions of enrollees, and those who lose Medicaid coverage receive a 90-day Marketplace SEP (extended window per CMS guidance) rather than the standard 60-day SEP. If you received a Medicaid termination letter in 2026, your SEP window for Marketplace enrollment may be 90 days from that notice, not 60. Call healthcare.gov at 1-800-318-2596 to confirm your specific window. The federal poverty level for 2026 is the income anchor for both your Medicaid eligibility check and your Marketplace subsidy calculation.
paragraphs.es: El proceso de desenrollamiento de Medicaid que comenzo en 2023 continua generando eventos calificadores en 2026. Los estados todavia estan redeterminando la elegibilidad de Medicaid para millones de inscritos, y aquellos que pierden cobertura de Medicaid reciben un SEP del Mercado de 90 dias (ventana extendida segun la guia de CMS) en lugar del SEP estandar de 60 dias. Si recibio una carta de terminacion de Medicaid en 2026, su ventana SEP puede ser de 90 dias desde ese aviso.

heading.en: Medicaid Eligibility After Missing Open Enrollment in 2026
heading.es: Elegibilidad de Medicaid Despues de Perder la Inscripcion Abierta en 2026

paragraphs.en: Medicaid is the fastest and most cost-effective fallback for anyone who missed ACA Open Enrollment in 2026. The 40 expansion states plus DC use a single income threshold: 138% of the Federal Poverty Level, which translates to $22,025 for a single person or $45,540 for a family of four based on the 2026 HHS poverty guidelines. State programs operate under different brand names that carry their own Bing and Google search identities: California's Medi-Cal, Arizona's AHCCCS, Wisconsin's BadgerCare, Massachusetts's MassHealth, Washington's Apple Health, Connecticut's HUSKY Health, Tennessee's TennCare, New Jersey's NJ FamilyCare, Oregon's OHP (Oregon Health Plan), and Indiana's HIP (Healthy Indiana Plan). Applications flow through healthcare.gov or directly through each state's portal. Most states make an eligibility determination within a few business days. Coverage typically starts the first day of the month after approval, though some states still provide retroactive coverage for up to three prior months for applicants who were eligible but not enrolled.
paragraphs.es: Medicaid es la alternativa mas rapida y rentable para cualquiera que perdio la Inscripcion Abierta del ACA en 2026. Los 40 estados con expansion mas DC usan un unico umbral de ingresos: el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, que equivale a $22,025 para una persona sola o $45,540 para una familia de cuatro segun las pautas de pobreza HHS 2026. Los programas estatales operan con diferentes nombres de marca: Medi-Cal de California, AHCCCS de Arizona, BadgerCare de Wisconsin, MassHealth de Massachusetts, Apple Health de Washington, HUSKY Health de Connecticut, TennCare de Tennessee, NJ FamilyCare de Nueva Jersey, OHP de Oregon, y HIP de Indiana.

paragraphs.en: The 10 non-expansion states (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin, and Wyoming) have narrower Medicaid eligibility rules and generally do not cover non-disabled adults below the ACA income threshold. Florida, Georgia, Texas, and the other non-expansion states leave a coverage gap for adults earning between roughly 0 and 100% FPL who do not have a disability. In those states, Marketplace plans at or below 100% FPL may offer $0-premium Bronze options through healthcare.gov, but coverage quality is limited compared to full Medicaid. If you live in a non-expansion state and your income is very low, contact the state Medicaid agency directly to ask about categorical eligibility programs for parents, pregnant women, or individuals with disabilities that operate separately from the ACA expansion.
paragraphs.es: Los 10 estados sin expansion (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Mississippi, Carolina del Sur, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin y Wyoming) tienen reglas de elegibilidad de Medicaid mas estrictas y generalmente no cubren a adultos no discapacitados por debajo del umbral de ingresos del ACA. En esos estados, los planes del Mercado en o por debajo del 100% FPL pueden ofrecer opciones Bronze de $0 de prima a traves de healthcare.gov.

heading.en: Documents Needed to Enroll Through a SEP or Medicaid in 2026
heading.es: Documentos Necesarios para Inscribirse a Traves de un SEP o Medicaid en 2026

paragraphs.en: Gathering documents before you apply eliminates the most common cause of SEP application delays: verification holds. Healthcare.gov requires documentation for most qualifying life events within 30 days of plan selection, though you can select a plan first and submit documents after. Medicaid verification requirements vary by state but typically require identity, residency, income, and citizenship or immigration status. The following checklist covers the standard documents needed for the most common pathways after missing Open Enrollment.
paragraphs.es: Reunir documentos antes de solicitar elimina la causa mas comun de retrasos en las solicitudes de SEP: las retenciones de verificacion. Healthcare.gov requiere documentacion para la mayoria de los eventos calificadores dentro de los 30 dias posteriores a la seleccion del plan, aunque puede seleccionar un plan primero y enviar documentos despues. Los requisitos de verificacion de Medicaid varian por estado pero tipicamente requieren identidad, residencia, ingresos y estatus de ciudadania o inmigracion.

list.en: Proof of loss of prior coverage: employer termination letter, COBRA election notice, or letter showing Medicaid or CHIP termination date
list.es: Prueba de perdida de cobertura anterior: carta de despido del empleador, aviso de eleccion de COBRA, o carta que muestre la fecha de terminacion de Medicaid o CHIP

list.en: Qualifying event documentation: marriage certificate, birth or adoption certificate, lease or utility bill showing new address (for move-based SEP)
list.es: Documentacion del evento calificador: acta de matrimonio, acta de nacimiento o adopcion, contrato de arrendamiento o factura de servicios que muestre nueva direccion (para SEP por mudanza)

list.en: Proof of income for all household members: two recent pay stubs, most recent federal tax return, or letter from employer. Self-employed applicants may use a profit-and-loss statement

heading.en: COBRA vs Marketplace SEP: Which Is Better After Missing Open Enrollment?
heading.es: COBRA vs SEP del Mercado: Cual Es Mejor Despues de Perder la Inscripcion Abierta?

paragraphs.en: COBRA and a Marketplace Special Enrollment Period are the two main options for people who recently had employer-based coverage and then missed the January 15 OEP deadline. COBRA preserves your exact employer plan, same network, same formulary, at 102% of the full premium. In 2026, COBRA costs typically range from $400 to $900 per month for an individual and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for family coverage, depending on the employer plan. COBRA is almost never the cheapest option once Marketplace premium tax credits are factored in, but it has one specific advantage: network continuity. If you are mid-treatment with a specialist not available in any Marketplace plan network in your area, COBRA preserves that relationship.
paragraphs.es: COBRA y un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado son las dos opciones principales para personas que recientemente tuvieron cobertura del empleador y luego perdieron la fecha limite del OEP del 15 de enero. COBRA conserva su plan exacto del empleador, misma red, mismo formulario, al 102% de la prima completa. En 2026, los costos de COBRA tipicamente oscilan entre $400 y $900 por mes para un individuo y $1,200 a $2,800 por mes para cobertura familiar.

paragraphs.en: ACA Marketplace plans available through a loss-of-coverage SEP in 2026 use Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) to calculate premium tax credits. At lower incomes, particularly below 200% FPL, Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions can cost $10 to $100 per month with comprehensive coverage including pre-existing conditions, essential health benefits, and out-of-pocket maximums capped at $10,600 for an individual in 2026. The decision matrix for Section 9831 (HIPAA) qualifying coverage applicants in 2026 is: Medicaid first if income is under 138% FPL; Marketplace SEP second if income is 100 to 400% FPL; spouse's employer plan if available within 30 days; COBRA as a last resort only for network-continuity needs or met deductibles. A 1095-A from the Marketplace in early 2027 will reconcile any premium tax credits with actual income.
paragraphs.es: Los planes del Mercado ACA disponibles a traves de un SEP por perdida de cobertura en 2026 usan el MAGI para calcular los creditos fiscales de primas. A ingresos mas bajos, particularmente por debajo del 200% FPL, los planes Silver con reducciones de costos compartidos pueden costar $10 a $100 por mes con cobertura integral incluidas condiciones preexistentes, beneficios esenciales de salud y maximos de bolsillo limitados a $10,600 para un individuo en 2026.

en: Proof of loss of prior coverage (employer termination letter, COBRA notice, or Medicaid or CHIP termination letter with end date)
Qualifying event documentation (marriage certificate, birth or adoption certificate, or lease or utility bill showing new address for move-based SEP)
Recent pay stubs (two most recent) or most recent federal tax return for income verification
Unemployment compensation award letter if receiving unemployment benefits (counted in MAGI for subsidy calculations)
Social Security numbers for all household members applying for coverage
Current address and ZIP code (determines plan availability and service area)
Photo ID for the primary applicant (driver's license, passport, or state-issued ID)
Immigration documents for non-citizen household members (green card, visa, I-94 arrival record)

Documentacion del evento calificador (acta de matrimonio, acta de nacimiento o adopcion, o contrato de arrendamiento o factura que muestre nueva direccion)
Recibos de pago recientes (los dos mas recientes) o declaracion federal de impuestos mas reciente para verificacion de ingresos
Carta de adjudicacion de compensacion por desempleo si recibe beneficios de desempleo (contados en MAGI para calculos de subsidio)
Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan cobertura
Direccion actual y codigo postal (determina disponibilidad de planes y area de servicio)
Identificacion con foto del solicitante principal (licencia de conducir, pasaporte o identificacion estatal)
Documentos de inmigracion para miembros del hogar no ciudadanos (tarjeta verde, visa, I-94)

en: Missing the 60-day SEP window: application submitted more than 60 days after the qualifying life event (60 days from job loss or 90 days from Medicaid termination for the Medicaid Unwinding SEP)
Insufficient documentation of the qualifying event: no termination letter, no marriage certificate, or no proof that prior coverage ended on a specific date
Reporting prior-year income instead of projected current-year income: ACA subsidy eligibility is based on Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) projected for the current year, not last year's return

Applying to the Marketplace when Medicaid eligibility exists: in expansion states, household income under 138% FPL routes to Medicaid automatically and cannot receive a Marketplace plan with subsidies simultaneously
Claiming a non-qualifying event as a qualifying event: routine schedule changes, voluntary coverage drops, or expiration of short-term plans do not trigger a Marketplace SEP
es: Perder la ventana SEP de 60 dias: solicitud enviada mas de 60 dias despues del evento calificador de vida (60 dias desde la perdida de empleo o 90 dias desde la terminacion de Medicaid para el SEP de desenrollamiento de Medicaid)
Documentacion insuficiente del evento calificador: sin carta de despido, sin acta de matrimonio, o sin prueba de que la cobertura anterior termino en una fecha especifica

Reportar ingresos del ano anterior en lugar de ingresos proyectados del ano actual: la elegibilidad de subsidio del ACA se basa en el MAGI proyectado para el ano actual, no en la declaracion del ano pasado

Solicitar al Mercado cuando existe elegibilidad de Medicaid: en estados con expansion, el ingreso del hogar por debajo del 138% FPL se dirige automaticamente a Medicaid y no puede recibir un plan del Mercado con subsidios simultaneamente
Reclamar un evento no calificador como evento calificador: cambios rutinarios de horario, abandonos voluntarios de cobertura, o expiracion de planes a corto plazo no activan un SEP del Mercado

heading.en: Medicaid vs Marketplace SEP vs COBRA: Which Path Should You Take?
heading.es: Medicaid vs SEP del Mercado vs COBRA: Que Camino Debe Tomar?

body.en: Medicaid is the first path to evaluate when you miss Open Enrollment in 2026. Enrollment is year-round, coverage costs nothing or nearly nothing in expansion states, and the income threshold of 138% FPL in expansion states ($22,025 for one person, $45,540 for a family of four) covers a large share of people who miss OEP due to income disruption. The Marketplace SEP is the second path for people with a qualifying life event who earn more than 138% FPL. At 100 to 250% FPL, Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions bring annual deductibles under $500 and monthly premiums to $10 to $50 after premium tax credits. COBRA preserves network access at 102% of the full premium but is rarely the cheapest choice once subsidies are factored in. The structured decision tree: check Medicaid first; if income is over 138% FPL, check for a qualifying event that opens a 60-day SEP; if a SEP is available, compare Marketplace plan costs against COBRA before electing; if no SEP and no Medicaid, mark November 1, 2026 for the next OEP and consider whether a short-term plan fills the gap without creating coverage surprises from uncovered pre-existing conditions.
body.es: Medicaid es el primer camino a evaluar cuando se pierde la Inscripcion Abierta en 2026. La inscripcion es todo el ano, la cobertura no cuesta nada o casi nada en estados con expansion, y el umbral de ingresos del 138% FPL cubre a muchas personas que pierden el OEP por interrupcion de ingresos. El SEP del Mercado es el segundo camino para personas con un evento calificador que ganan mas del 138% FPL. COBRA conserva el acceso a la red al 102% de la prima completa pero rara vez es la opcion mas barata una vez que se consideran los subsidios. El arbol de decision estructurado: verificar Medicaid primero; si el ingreso supera el 138% FPL, buscar un evento calificador que abra un SEP de 60 dias; si hay un SEP disponible, comparar costos del plan del Mercado contra COBRA antes de elegir; si no hay SEP ni Medicaid, marcar el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para el proximo OEP.

stateRules.rule: Covered California (the state exchange) has historically offered extended OEP deadlines and year-round enrollment for income-qualifying applicants, plus Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) is available year-round for those under 138% FPL.
NY State of Health extends Open Enrollment later than healthcare.gov in most years and offers the Essential Plan for income between 138% and 200% FPL at $0 to $20/month.
Massachusetts Health Connector has a year-round SEP for any uninsured resident and MassHealth (Massachusetts Medicaid) covers up to 133% FPL.
Washington Healthplanfinder offers year-round enrollment for Apple Health (Medicaid) and a special enrollment period any time for income under 200% FPL through the state exchange.

en.question: What are my health insurance options if I missed Open Enrollment 2026?
en.answer: Four options remain after the January 15, 2026 ACA Open Enrollment deadline. First, Medicaid is year-round for households with income under 138% of the 2026 Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 for one person, $45,540 for a family of four) in the 40 expansion states plus DC. Second, CHIP covers children under 19 year-round in most income ranges. Third, a 60-day Special Enrollment Period opens if you had a qualifying life event such as job loss, marriage, birth, a move, or loss of Medicaid since January 15, 2026. Fourth, the next ACA Open Enrollment for 2027 coverage opens November 1, 2026 on healthcare.gov. Check Medicaid eligibility first since it is the fastest and least expensive path.

en.question: What is the SEP window if I had a qualifying event after Open Enrollment closed?
en.answer: A qualifying life event triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period starting on the date of the event. For example, if you lost job-based coverage on April 15, 2026, your Marketplace SEP window runs April 15 through June 14, 2026. If you lost Medicaid coverage due to a state redetermination, your SEP window may be 90 days per CMS Medicaid Unwinding guidance rather than the standard 60 days. Qualifying events include job loss, marriage, birth or adoption, moving to a new state or county with different plan availability, and loss of Medicaid or CHIP. Call healthcare.gov at 1-800-318-2596 or apply online to verify your specific event and window.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove a qualifying life event for the SEP?
en.answer: Healthcare.gov requires documentation of the qualifying event within 30 days of plan selection, though you can choose a plan first. For job loss, submit an employer termination letter or COBRA election notice showing the coverage end date. For marriage, submit a marriage certificate. For birth or adoption, submit the birth certificate or adoption order. For a move, submit a signed lease, utility bill, or other proof of new address in a different county or state. For loss of Medicaid, submit the termination letter from your state Medicaid agency. Having these documents ready before you start the application eliminates the most common cause of SEP holds and delays.

en.question: Can I get Medicaid after missing Open Enrollment?
en.answer: Yes. Medicaid enrollment is year-round with no Open Enrollment deadline. In the 40 Medicaid expansion states plus DC, anyone with 2026 household income under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level qualifies regardless of when they apply. That is $22,025 for a single person or $45,540 for a family of four using the 2026 HHS poverty guidelines. Apply through healthcare.gov or your state Medicaid agency. State programs have different brand names: Medi-Cal in California, AHCCCS in Arizona, BadgerCare in Wisconsin, MassHealth in Massachusetts, and Apple Health in Washington. In the 10 non-expansion states, Medicaid eligibility is narrower and generally limited to parents of minors, pregnant women, and people with disabilities.

en.question: Is COBRA worth it after missing Open Enrollment?
en.answer: Rarely for cost reasons alone. COBRA charges 102% of the full employer and employee premium. In 2026, that typically ranges from $400 to $900 per month for an individual and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for family coverage. ACA Marketplace plans available through a qualifying-event SEP almost always cost less after premium tax credits for people with incomes between 100% and 400% FPL. COBRA's main advantage is network continuity: if you are in the middle of treatment with a specialist who is not in any Marketplace network in your area, COBRA may be worth the higher cost for a short period. The COBRA election window is 60 days from the qualifying event, and you can elect it retroactively to the event date, which allows you to compare Marketplace plan options first before deciding.

en.question: What if I have no qualifying event and do not qualify for Medicaid?
en.answer: Without a qualifying life event and without Medicaid eligibility, your main options are: (1) wait for the next ACA Open Enrollment that opens November 1, 2026 on healthcare.gov for 2027 coverage, with enrollment closing January 15, 2027; (2) enroll in a short-term limited-duration plan as a bridge, understanding these plans are not ACA-compliant, can deny claims for pre-existing conditions, and do not provide essential health benefits; (3) check whether you qualify for a state-specific program such as New York's Essential Plan or Washington's Cascade Care for lower-income residents. Federal community health centers (FQHCs) also provide sliding-scale primary care at reduced cost even without insurance. Contact your nearest FQHC through the HRSA finder at findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov.

en.question: When does the next ACA Open Enrollment open for 2027 coverage?
en.answer: ACA Open Enrollment for 2027 coverage opens November 1, 2026 on healthcare.gov and most state-based marketplaces. Enroll by December 15, 2026 for coverage starting January 1, 2027. The enrollment window closes January 15, 2027 on healthcare.gov. Some state-based marketplaces may have extended deadlines past January 15. Enroll before December 15 to ensure no gap between your current coverage expiration and 2027 coverage start. Set a reminder now. If you qualify for Medicaid or a SEP before November, do not wait for OEP.

en.question: What about my children's coverage if I missed Open Enrollment?
en.answer: Children under 19 qualify for CHIP year-round regardless of whether the parent missed Open Enrollment. CHIP income limits range from about 200% to 300% of FPL depending on the state, and premiums are typically $0 to $50 per month. Children who qualify for Medicaid are covered under that program instead. Even if your own income is too high for Medicaid, your children may qualify for CHIP based on household size and income. Apply at healthcare.gov or your state Medicaid or CHIP agency. All 50 states plus DC operate CHIP programs with state-specific brand names such as Illinois's AllKids, New Jersey's NJ FamilyCare, and Colorado's CHP+. Your children do not have to wait until Open Enrollment.

es.question: Cuales son mis opciones de seguro medico si perdi la Inscripcion Abierta 2026?
es.answer: Quedan cuatro opciones despues de la fecha limite del 15 de enero de 2026. Primero, Medicaid es todo el ano para hogares con ingresos por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 ($22,025 para una persona, $45,540 para una familia de cuatro) en los 40 estados con expansion mas DC. Segundo, CHIP cubre ninos menores de 19 anos todo el ano en la mayoria de rangos de ingresos. Tercero, un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias se abre si tuvo un evento calificador como perdida de empleo, matrimonio, nacimiento, mudanza o perdida de Medicaid desde el 15 de enero de 2026. Cuarto, la proxima Inscripcion Abierta para cobertura 2027 abre el 1 de noviembre de 2026 en healthcare.gov.

es.question: Cual es la ventana SEP si tuve un evento calificador despues de que cerro la Inscripcion Abierta?
es.answer: Un evento calificador de vida activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias que comienza en la fecha del evento. Por ejemplo, si perdio cobertura del trabajo el 15 de abril de 2026, su ventana SEP del Mercado va del 15 de abril al 14 de junio de 2026. Si perdio cobertura de Medicaid por una redeterminacion estatal, su ventana SEP puede ser de 90 dias segun la guia de CMS sobre el desenrollamiento de Medicaid. Los eventos calificadores incluyen perdida de empleo, matrimonio, nacimiento o adopcion, mudanza a un nuevo estado o condado, y perdida de Medicaid o CHIP. Llame a healthcare.gov al 1-800-318-2596 para verificar su evento y ventana especificos.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para probar un evento calificador para el SEP?
es.answer: Healthcare.gov requiere documentacion del evento calificador dentro de los 30 dias posteriores a la seleccion del plan, aunque puede elegir un plan primero. Para perdida de empleo, presente carta de despido del empleador o aviso de eleccion de COBRA con la fecha de fin de cobertura. Para matrimonio, presente acta de matrimonio. Para nacimiento o adopcion, presente el acta de nacimiento u orden de adopcion. Para mudanza, presente un contrato de arrendamiento firmado, factura de servicios u otra prueba de nueva direccion. Para perdida de Medicaid, presente la carta de terminacion de su agencia estatal de Medicaid.

es.question: Puedo obtener Medicaid despues de perder la Inscripcion Abierta?
es.answer: Si. La inscripcion en Medicaid es todo el ano sin fecha limite de Inscripcion Abierta. En los 40 estados con expansion de Medicaid mas DC, cualquier persona con ingreso del hogar en 2026 por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza califica independientemente de cuando solicite. Eso es $22,025 para una persona sola o $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. Solicite a traves de healthcare.gov o su agencia estatal de Medicaid. Los programas estatales tienen diferentes nombres de marca: Medi-Cal en California, AHCCCS en Arizona, BadgerCare en Wisconsin, MassHealth en Massachusetts, y Apple Health en Washington.

es.question: Vale la pena COBRA despues de perder la Inscripcion Abierta?
es.answer: Rara vez solo por razones de costo. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima completa del empleador y del empleado. En 2026, eso tipicamente oscila entre $400 y $900 por mes para un individuo y $1,200 a $2,800 por mes para cobertura familiar. Los planes del Mercado ACA disponibles a traves de un SEP de evento calificador casi siempre cuestan menos despues de los creditos fiscales de primas para personas con ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL. La principal ventaja de COBRA es la continuidad de la red: si esta en medio de un tratamiento con un especialista que no esta en ninguna red del Mercado en su area, COBRA puede valer el costo mas alto por un periodo corto.

es.question: Que pasa si no tengo un evento calificador y no califico para Medicaid?
es.answer: Sin un evento calificador de vida y sin elegibilidad para Medicaid, sus opciones principales son: (1) esperar la proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA que abre el 1 de noviembre de 2026 en healthcare.gov para cobertura 2027, con inscripcion que cierra el 15 de enero de 2027; (2) inscribirse en un plan de duracion limitada a corto plazo como puente, entendiendo que estos planes no son conformes con el ACA, pueden negar reclamos por condiciones preexistentes; (3) verificar si califica para un programa estatal especifico como el Plan Esencial de Nueva York. Los centros de salud comunitarios federales tambien brindan atencion primaria a precio reducido incluso sin seguro.

es.question: Cuando abre la proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA para cobertura 2027?
es.answer: La Inscripcion Abierta del ACA para cobertura 2027 abre el 1 de noviembre de 2026 en healthcare.gov y en la mayoria de los mercados estatales. Inscribase antes del 15 de diciembre de 2026 para que la cobertura comience el 1 de enero de 2027. La ventana de inscripcion cierra el 15 de enero de 2027 en healthcare.gov. Algunos mercados estatales pueden tener fechas limite extendidas mas alla del 15 de enero. Establezca un recordatorio ahora. Si califica para Medicaid o un SEP antes de noviembre, no espere al OEP.

es.question: Que pasa con la cobertura de mis hijos si perdi la Inscripcion Abierta?
es.answer: Los ninos menores de 19 anos califican para CHIP todo el ano independientemente de si el padre perdio la Inscripcion Abierta. Los limites de ingresos de CHIP oscilan entre aproximadamente el 200% y el 300% del FPL segun el estado, y las primas son tipicamente de $0 a $50 por mes. Los ninos que califican para Medicaid estan cubiertos bajo ese programa. Incluso si sus ingresos son demasiado altos para Medicaid, sus hijos pueden calificar para CHIP. Solicite en healthcare.gov o su agencia estatal de Medicaid o CHIP. Los 50 estados mas DC tienen programas CHIP con nombres de marca especificos como AllKids de Illinois, NJ FamilyCare de Nueva Jersey y CHP+ de Colorado.
